source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Enter BMC Web UI -> Select "Hardware status" > Click tab "Inventory and LEDs" then check the Chassis information and detail information
And Compare FRU data with ipmitool fru print to check if contect correct or not

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Data should be readable and correct.

historical_reviews.deepseek: YES assumes one FRU_FAN endpoint, selects three fields and weakens TLS without proving fan-FRU count, slot/assembly relation, complete IPMI parity or identifier protection.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION / CHANGED requires complete FRU member-to-fan topology, protected Redfish/IPMI/UI evidence and separation of identity from live fan health.

historical_reviews.related_source_cases: Speed-channel cases validate live tach/status, not fan FRU identity; a single assembly FRU may cover multiple rotors and must not be treated as every fan.

original_test_intent: Verify the fan FRU data shown by BMC is readable, correct and consistent with read-only IPMI FRU evidence.
original_method: Determine whether FRU_FAN represents individual modules or assemblies, map every FRU record to fan slots/rotors, collect complete protected Redfish and IPMI identity data, and compare with WebUI and the approved cooling asset reference without controlling fans.
manual_activity: The owner defines fan FRU granularity, topology and expected asset fields. The agent may perform protected reads/comparison; relation to live fan health and final verdict remain engineer-owned.
required_inputs: Fan FRU member count and granularity
safety_requirements: Do not write FRU, change fan control/thresholds, disconnect/reseat, power-cycle or reset.
Do not assume one FRU_FAN record represents every physical fan.
Use trusted transport and protected credentials.
Redact serial and asset identifiers in shared evidence.
Stop on ambiguous FRU-to-fan relation without automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Resolve all actual FRU_FAN members and their fan/assembly relations.
Collect complete redacted Redfish and approved read-only IPMI records.
Normalize manufacturer, product, part/serial and all required fields.
Correlate WebUI, topology and asset reference; reference telemetry only for identity relation.
Return evidence only with fan and FRU state unchanged.
engineer_actions: Approve FRU granularity and slot/assembly map.
Resolve mismatches and issue formal verdict.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Partial only: assumed one endpoint and three fields do not prove all fan FRUs, slot/assembly relations, complete IPMI/UI parity or trusted evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Enumerate the actual fan FRU resources, map them to assemblies/slots, and compare complete protected Redfish/IPMI/UI records without control actions.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: FRU_FAN, WebUI/ipmitool comparison, Criterion and original time values remain preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use complete topology-bound fan-FRU parity under no-control/no-write constraints.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: All Project-defined fan FRU devices or assemblies.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC, Redfish schema and IPMI decoder versions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Vendor cooling/FRU topology and Project asset record.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds FRU granularity and fan relation, complete protected fields and explicit identity-versus-telemetry separation while retaining source interfaces.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Three fields from one endpoint cannot prove every fan FRU or current fan health; identity does not establish RPM/airflow.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: FRU count/topology, device mapping and complete asset baseline.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A fan assembly may contain multiple rotors; treating it as one-to-one can hide missing/swapped modules, while control actions can affect cooling.

project_override_considerations: Alternate inventory tools require exact fan-FRU/assembly identity, field equivalence and engineer approval; uncovered WebUI/IPMI or live-telemetry coverage must be stated.
expected_evidence: Fan FRU count/granularity and slot/assembly topology
Complete raw redacted Redfish/IPMI records and mapping
Normalized per-FRU field matrix plus telemetry-relation note

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master consistently asks for fan FRU parity; member granularity and topology are missing Project details, not contradictory purposes.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Fan FRU identity is clear; member count, mapping and expected values are execution-readiness inputs.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Adds complete member/assembly mapping, full fields, trusted transport and IPMI/UI parity.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Independently agrees with hybrid classification and no-control/no-write boundary.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.round_02: Replaces assumed single-endpoint acceptance with topology and completeness gates.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.related_source_cases: Separates persistent fan identity from speed/health telemetry coverage.

review_improvement: Prevents one partial assembly record from being counted as every fan and makes FRU identity versus live cooling evidence explicit.
independent_technical_reasoning: Fan FRUs may be per module, per tray or per cooling assembly, while telemetry may be per rotor. The test can only claim inventory correctness after that cardinality and mapping are approved; static FRU parity cannot prove current speed or health and does not authorize fan manipulation.
